message: ナナカのナイショ

name: Synn
message: 「I made it back this far without anyone spotting me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well duh, it's Sunday」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though things were just getting exciting」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn? What're you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah! N-Nanaka!? Why are you here!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「On my way home」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right. Then I am too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Weren't you thinking of sneaking into the Student Council room to prep for KiraFes?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Gah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your reactions are way too easy to read」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're doing the exact same thing, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you, I'm on my way home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai told you to 'take the day off for once,' didn't she?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When Ria-chan says it, man... Even yours truly was thinking this might be a bad idea」

name: Synn
message: 「Betrayal out of nowhere!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You make it sound so awful」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I don't have anything to do even if I go home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tending your vegetable garden, fixing up your rundown apartment, getting attacked by Sasami--you've got plenty to do, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Getting attacked isn't on my to-do list. What about you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was thinking maybe I'd help out at my parents' place」

name: Synn
message: 「You already do that all the time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've been so busy lately that I haven't really been able to help out much」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, you don't have to help out too, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Yet I will help」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's your rare day off, so you should get some proper rest」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm always indebted to you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you not to worry about that stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not worrying. I'm grateful」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You call it taking care of you, but all I do is wake you up in the morning once in a while and make you soba once in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「And it's a huge help」

name: Paqy
message: 「That soba is damn good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I do all that stuff just 'cause I want to」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll help out just 'cause I want to, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You won't make a single cent, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gratitude requires no money」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh. Kinda cool, aren't we」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds like a mindset that'll never save any cash」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'm gonna work you to the bone then」

name: Synn
message: 「...Go a little easy on me」
Busy working on her feet, Auntie Yuugiri looked like she wanted to chat with me endlessly, but that wouldn't be much help, so I kept it to a greeting and headed into the back kitchen.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm back! Synn says he's gonna help out today!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been a while」
Giving me a small, silent nod in return was Uncle Yuugiri.
He's burly all over, practically bursting out of his white cook's apron.
On top of that, underneath his white cap is a gloriously smooth, shiny skinhead.
He's the complete opposite of Auntie, who is slender, petite, talkative, and pretty.
He's an extremely taciturn man--even I, who've known him for a long time, have never heard his voice, though...
'Glad you came. Well, take it easy'
'Taking it easy when I'm here to help wouldn't be right'
'Hahaha.'
Mr. Yuugiri gave a small chuckle.
For some reason, we can communicate just by looking into each other's eyes.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You guys are making eye contact again.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just somehow get what he's saying.」
'Honestly, if you'd just take over Yuugiri-an--along with my daughter, of course.'
'Come on, stop joking around.'
'If it's you, Synn-kun, I'd be at ease.'
Hmm.
Every now and then, I wonder if we're actually communicating at all.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm interested in soba-making, see. So I'd appreciate it if you'd leave me right here until you're done helping out.」
'Um... could you hold onto this doll here for me?'
'Just put it up on the shelf in front of me.'
Is this really okay?
...Well, we're on the same wavelength, so it's probably fine, right?
Alright, all changed.
Let's do this!
The menu hasn't changed since the last time I helped out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you spacing out like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking at it again... the soba at your place is expensive!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You think so? All good soba places charge around this much.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa. Whoa, whoa. I-It was really this pricey!?」
I've been scarfing down food this expensive at least twice a week...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you only realizing that now? You always eat it without batting an eye.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, well... once I'm aware of it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've never once paid money when I eat the soba my dad makes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, obviously.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the same for you, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, to us, you're basically part of the family.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... Hearing you say that... makes me happy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's why you shouldn't worry about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Thanks, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... that's not the only reason, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, if you feel even a tiny bit bad about it, why don't you become part of the family for real?」

name: Synn
message: 「For real?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like, marrying me and becoming our son-in-law?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-what are you talking about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just kidding. A joke, a joke」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you take me seriously for a second there?」

name: Synn
message: 「As if!」
And so, time to help out.
Welcome in. Take orders, carry out the food, say thank you very much, clean up--and repeat.

name: Synn
message: 「Right away, welcome!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yo. Synn's helping out today, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「The Yuugiri family is always taking care of me, after all」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Speaking of which, Kirafes is right around the corner. Going smoothly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to everyone's help」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I haven't done anything much. If you're gonna be grateful, you'd be wasting it if you didn't thank those beauties on the Student Council」

name: Synn
message: 「I am grateful to them」
I hand Tame-san a wet towel.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Thanks. So, where's the young miss?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's making soba with Uncle」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Synn handling the customers while the young miss makes the soba... That's a pretty nice picture of the future」

name: Synn
message: 「Picture of the future?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Of Yuugiri-an twenty years from now. Hey there, future young master」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, what's taking you so long?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh. Here comes the future young proprietress」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm tired of hearing that joke, so please place your order」

name: Tame-san
message: 「You wouldn't want Synn?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A good-for-nothing like him is out of the question. He doesn't have any money, either. So, your order?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Good-for-nothing...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Harsh. Don't you have any comeback as the young master?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh. I curse my empty wallet」

name: Tame-san
message: 「True enough, Synn really is hopeless」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not true」

name: Tame-san
message: 「He's broke, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He just doesn't have any right now--things could be different in the future, couldn't they?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, but isn't he a good-for-nothing?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is doing a fantastic job as Student Council President. He is not a good-for-nothing」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Pretty sure you were the one who called Synn a broke good-for-nothing, young miss...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...If you don't order, I'm kicking you out」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Whoa, scary, scary. Tempura soba, then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, they said you can clock out」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Isn't it still early, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine, it's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm heading off to Ryuusei Academy to deliver some soba」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you get an order from the dorms?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope. The delivery's for the Student Council room」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Everyone's probably starting to get hungry right about now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yup, that's right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, my old man told me I can just clock out once I'm done with the delivery」

name: Synn
message: 「You're so thoughtful, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh. Naturally」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hellooo~ Delivery from Yuugiri-an!」

name: Synn
message: 「Six orders of zaru soba!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat!?」
Right before my eyes was the exact sight I'd expected.

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh?! Who ordered delivery?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I didn't order anything」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't order it, either, though it's good timing for my stomach」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, smells good! What is that?! What is it?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-da! Soba from my family's place, Yuugiri-an!」

name: Sally
message: 「Food?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Food! And it's delicious!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eat, eat, I wanna eat right now!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're fine with anything as long as it's food, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... U-Um, why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I figured you'd all be getting hungry right about now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It wasn't me, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Um, Sally-san?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nope. It's definitely Ria's stomach」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahh, even the growling of her stomach is adorable...」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't fight on an empty stomach」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, sneaking ahead on your own is no good, no good at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing Student Council activities while leaving out the Student Council President and Treasurer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is this a new form of bullying!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bullying is uncool」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, why did even Synn-kun have to come along!」

name: Ria
message: 「Breaking the rules yourself as the Student Council President is no good, you know. As the former Student Council President, I'm gonna get mad at you」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming from Ria-senpai, who's right here herself, that has zero persuasiveness」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahh, to think that Synn-kun, who used to be so cute, would start talking back to me...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It wasn't me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have been hiding it until now, but the one whose stomach just growled was me」

name: Misa
message: 「You weren't hiding anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, let's leave that talk aside for now. Everyone's hungry, right? Here you go」
Nanaka and I line up the bowls of soba on the table.

name: Sally
message: 「This is soba? It's so loooong and thin!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey. Don't eat it with your bare hands」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuu. If I don't eat soon, I'm gonna starve to death」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom nom. This is delicious soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's already eating!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone. Before eating, we say 'itadakimasu'」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister... Even when you're so hungry your stomach is growling, you never forget your manners... How admirable!」

name: Ria
message: 「Something like this is only natural」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the food! *Nom*」

name: Sally
message: 「--!? It's delicious! Whoa, so good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right, soy sauce right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you for the meal...」

name: Misa
message: 「...! Th-This really is...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Delicious~~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This texture that gently unravels in my mouth. Rich and smooth, yet not heavy, with an elegant and deeply savory flavor」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it the nectar of heaven, or perhaps the tempting nectar that lures one into depravity... Truly exquisite!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... I'm not even sure how to retort to that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't sound like you're describing the taste of soba at all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The guidebook said that when something is delicious, praising it like this works for anything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Descriptions aside, as long as you think it's tasty, it's all good!」

name: Sally
message: 「So good! Yummy! The best!」

name: Ria
message: 「Did your father make this soba, Nanaka-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I made it myself!」

name: Ria
message: 「Really... That's amazing!」

name: Misa
message: 「You really can't judge a book by its cover...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer. You shouldn't show off like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're gonna get hurt if you stay trapped in your own narrow common sense, angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is soba that Nanaka made. I've been eating it forever, so take my word for it, there's no mistake」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'll vouch for it too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm still nowhere near as good as my old man, though. Still, I'm gonna surpass him someday!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, aren't you guys exaggerating? All of you going on about how delicious it is. What's the point of showering Nanaka with so much praise?」

name: Misa
message: 「To not appreciate something this delicious! As Student Council President--or before that, as a man, no, as a human being--I have to question your sensibilities!」

name: Synn
message: 「Disqualified as a human being!?」

name: Ria
message: 「With a flavor like this, there's no room for complaint. I think anyone would say it's delicious」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Do you have a fever or something? It's GO to the hospital for you」

name: Sally
message: 「If you don't think it's good, gimme it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Not good?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant! There's no doubt it's delicious, it's just...」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I see. I get it now. So that's how it is」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I kinda figured it out too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it really is a trip to the hospital, then!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn here ain't never eaten soba made by anyone other than the Yuugiri family. Probably」

name: Synn
message: 「Since I've only ever eaten soba made by Nanaka or your dad... I just thought this was how it normally tasted」

name: Misa
message: 「How utterly spoiled and ungrateful can you be!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you don't have to get that mad」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Nanaka... I always thought it was good, I just didn't realize it was world-class delicious...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to jump straight to world-class... It's fine, I told you I'm not mad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though I was a little shocked until I realized why」

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, I'll turn over a new leaf and eat every bite filled with emotion and gratitude」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you really don't have to」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, being able to eat such delicious soba on a regular basis makes you a winner in life, President」

name: Synn
message: 「I was a winner all along!」

name: Misa
message: 「Which means without Nanaka-san, you'd be a loser」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Misa, thank you」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What is it, all of a sudden」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For getting so angry for me」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I got angry for your sake, Nanaka-san. I just thought that something of value deserves to be treated according to its worth」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks. If you liked it, come by the shop to eat sometime too, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right. I'll think about it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone! Eat up before the noodles get soggy. There's soba-yu too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth happened!?」

name: Sally
message: 「My soba is all gone...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well yeah, it disappears when you eat it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That was delicious~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew... I'm somehow in the mood for some green tea」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go!」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Thank you very much!」

name: Sally
message: 「The tea's yummy too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Once we've rested after eating, Student Council activities are back on! Synn and I can join in this time, right?」
Of course, not a single one of their friends voiced any objection.
